column7: KEYORIX_DB_PASSWORD was spliced into storage.database.dsn (#3159, v0.96.0): a keyword DSN ending in a backslash let the password inject sslmode=disable/host=, and a URL DSN with ? in the userinfo made pgx connect to another host with sslmode=prefer (REVIEW-3162B). The DSN is now parsed by pgx and the password set on the parsed config; nothing outside internal/config reads the DSN or password (TestPostgresCredentialsReachTheDriverOnlyAsParsedConfig). Red on fb0926d9 (host=evil / host=u), green after. Fuzz: FuzzResolvePostgresConnConfig_PasswordCannotChangeConnection.
